content_blocks.text: This guide relates to registering as a supplier on the new central digital platform (Find a Tender)
What is the Central Digital Platform?
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?

content_blocks.text: Registration in 3 easy steps
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
Registration in 3 easy steps

content_blocks.text: Every supplier should assign a single person to initially set up and and register their organisation. This person will be the Administrator and will be able to add and approve other users. The Administrator will also enter and amend all of the details about the organisation.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
Registration in 3 easy steps

content_blocks.text: To get started, visit our user registration page and complete the following steps to create an account.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
Registration in 3 easy steps

content_blocks.text: If you already have a GOV.UK One Login account, select ‘Sign in’ and skip to step 2 or, if you do not have an account, follow the step 1 below to register.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
Registration in 3 easy steps

content_blocks.text: STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: To register for a GOV.UK One Login account, select ‘Create your Gov.UK One Login’ which will load the following page.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: Enter your individual work email address here, then view and agree to the terms of use, and privacy policy.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: A code will be sent to your email address. Once you receive the 6 digit security code, enter when prompted on the next screen. Your email might take a few minutes to arrive and you may need to check your spam folder.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: You will then be asked to choose a password.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: Next, you will now have to choose how to receive security codes. You can choose from receiving a text message or by an authentication app.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: If you selected the text message option, an SMS text message will be sent from GOVUK to your registered mobile phone number with a 6-digit verification code. The code may take a few minutes to arrive and will expire after 15 minutes.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: You should enter this code on the next page and continue.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: You will have now created a GOV.UK One Login!.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP ONE: Register for GOV.UK One Login

content_blocks.text: STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: Once you have created your GOV.UK One Login or signed in, you will then proceed to finalise your registration for the Central Digital Platform.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You should now read and agree to the Central Digital Platform service privacy policy.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will then be asked to enter your first and last name.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: Once you select continue, the following page will load displaying your account details and the option to register an organisation.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP TWO: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will need to have to hand the organisation’s Companies House number or an equivalent, like a Charity Commission number, and the registered address.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: If you do not have a relevant registered account number the platform will assign you one.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will first need to select ‘Register an organisation’ from the ‘My account’ page as shown above. You will then be asked whether you wish to register as a Buyer or Supplier - select Supplier.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will now be asked if your organisation has a Companies House number. If you do, you will be prompted to enter one.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: If you do not have a Companies House number, select ‘No’ and you will be prompted with the below alternative options. If none apply, you will be generated a unique identifier.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: If appropriate, select your SME status.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will now check or enter your organisation’s registered name. If you previously entered a Companies House number, this will be automatically populated from Companies House.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: You will now enter your organisation’s email address. This should be a shared email that other members of your team can access. When registering, you have the option to retain the notices and save searches on your old account by reregistering with the same email addresses. If you register with a new email address, your old information will not be pulled through.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: Next, check or enter your organisation’s registered address. As before, this will be automatically populated if you entered a Companies House number. You also have the option to enter a non-UK address on this page.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: The next screen will allow you to check your answers, and make any necessary changes, before proceeding to select ‘save’ and completing the registration of your organisation.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: Selecting ‘Save’ will load the following page to display your registered organisation.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: To see the details of the organisation and find your unique identifier, select ‘View’.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration

content_blocks.text: On this page, you will see your organisation’s details, including your identifier as highlighted. Share this unique identifier with the contracting authority before being awarded a contract.
heading_path: What is the Central Digital Platform?
STEP THREE: Complete Central Digital Platform Registration
